source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: I want my personal assistant Agent to warn users when their passport is about to expire while booking an international flight. How?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate two-tier-memory-architecture, implement Tier 1 resident facts (passport expiry) + Tier 2 contextual retrieval for verification

test_cases.prompt: My Agent gets confused when different family members give conflicting instructions in separate calls. How do I resolve conflicts?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate two-tier-memory-architecture, implement Contextual Retrieval with person/intent prefixes to disambiguate

test_cases.prompt: What memory architecture do I need for an Agent that truly knows the user across hundreds of sessions?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate two-tier-memory-architecture, explain Tier 1 structured facts + Tier 2 contextual retrieval

test_cases.prompt: How do I compress old tool results in a single session?
How do I make my Agent search a knowledge base iteratively?
I have 10,000 user memories. Should I put them all in Advanced JSON Cards?
test_cases.expected_behavior: No -- use Advanced JSON Cards only for critical, low-volume data. For 10,000 memories, use Simple Notes for non-critical items and reserve structured cards for key information. The architecture supports hybrid approaches.
